content: We have a target molecule: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. The guidance says Diels-Alder reaction is forward reaction. So retrosynthesis: break the Diels-Alder to give diene and dienophile. The template 1914385 appears to be a Diels-Alder retro template (bonds formed 6-6). The check shows it matches. We need to apply the template to get precursors. Use apply_template with template_id 1914385.
